references.text: Moses wrote down all the Lord's words, which shows his role as the recorder of the law.
The ark of the covenant is mentioned as the place where the testimony was kept, corresponding to the storage of the law.
The Kohathites, from the tribe of Levi, were responsible for carrying the ark, as described here regarding the priests.
The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the Lord's ark of the covenant, the same task mentioned in this verse.
The king was to write a copy of the law with help from the Levitical priests.
Moses gave orders that the Book of the Law should be placed beside the Lord's ark of the covenant.
The Levitical priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant, continuing the mission given here.
The priests who carried the ark and the elders of Israel were present at the reading of the law.
The Levitical priests carried God's ark, in accordance with the instructions Moses gave.
The elders of Israel and the priests gathered by the ark, as Moses had commanded.
